[EN] My nestbrothers will never let us near Sikander, nor the temple. They've forgotten their mission, their sacred duty!

You must kill the sikandari defenders and weaken the heretics.

Bring back their crests. They don't deserve to wear them any longer.
[ES] ¡Mis hermanos de nido NUNCA nos dejarán acercarnos a Sikander, ni al templo! ¡Han olvidado su misión, su sagrado deber!

Debes matar a los defensores sikandaris y debilitar a los herejes.

Trae de vuelta sus crestas. Ya no merecen usarlas.

[EN] I grieve for my nestbrothers, but Sikander would never sanction the deaths of your people for his sake.

Don't let their deaths be in vain, .
[ES] Me entristecen mis hermanos de nido, pero Sikander nunca aprobaría la muerte de tu gente por su bien.

No dejes que sus muertes sean en vano, .

[EN] Did you deal with the defenders already?
[ES] ¿Ya te encargaste de los defensores?
